prompts.landscape: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one original high-quality atmospheric transition painting for a Chinese interactive illustrated scroll report. Wide panoramic 3:1 composition, no text, no figures or people, no interfaces, no calligraphy, no seals, no watermarks. This is the bridge from a deep teal mountain painting to warm ivory reading paper. TOP EDGE and upper 12% must be solid deep mineral blue teal approximately #102d34; then wisps of luminous morning mist and delicate flowing river fog sweep diagonally downward. A tiny distant blue-green mountain shoulder and fine pine branch emerge only at the far right edge. The lower half dissolves into a large empty expanse of warm ivory silk approximately #f2efe5. The very bottom edge is clean ivory with no dark detail. Exceptional fine-brush mineral-pigment texture, poetic understated depth, quiet not busy. No borders, rectangular panels, frames, or extra objects. Keep the middle and lower half low contrast and text-safe. It should feel like fog opening into the next section of the same hanging scroll, never a modern gradient wallpaper.
prompts.celestial: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one original premium dark Eastern fantasy book chapter transition artwork. Wide panoramic 3:1 composition, no characters, people, readable text, letters, numbers, symbols resembling writing, logos or watermark. Color field is midnight ink blue #101b2a. Top edge matches even darker midnight #0d1727. Subtle richly painted flowing indigo silk clouds, a fine antique gold engraved wave motif and a SMALL carefully crafted moon-and-river insignia at the far left (x10%, y45%), like a physical inlaid bronze ornament on a precious folio. Gold must be muted and restrained, no glowing magic explosion. Fine gold dust only near insignia and outer left edge. Centre and right two thirds very quiet near-solid dark ink silk, safe for live typography. Bottom quarter dissolves into perfectly calm #101b2a. Original sophisticated textile and metal texture, tactile museum object quality. No large circle, no generic card frame, no ornate full border, no tarot imagery. This should extend a character collectible artwork into its readable archive chapter without distracting from text.
